tools.name: list_items
tools.description: The items a design can go on: key, name, the blank it is printed on, price per piece, colors, sizes, and the print areas with their sizes in inches. Call this before quoting or when the customer asks what is available. Prices are per piece in US dollars; the first print area is in the price and each

tools.name: design_item
tools.description: Make a print-ready design from a short description, for one item in one color. Returns a watermarked preview of the design on the item, a design_id for revise_design and open_in_studio, and how many free designs are left. Describe the ARTWORK only ("a snarling wolf head, two colors"), not the garmen

tools.name: revise_design
tools.description: Redo an existing design with a change: a different color scheme, fewer details, bolder lines, a different pose, words added or removed. Works from the design, so the result stays recognizably the same piece. Spends one from the allowance like design_item. Returns a new design_id; the old one still e

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: What an order would cost: per piece by size, the pieces, any volume discount, shipping, and the total before sales tax (tax is added at checkout where it applies). Nothing is charged. Use the sizes the customer named; a line is one item in one color with a count per size.

tools.name: open_in_studio
tools.description: A link that opens the aipromodesign.com designer with the design already on the item in that color and, when sizes are given, the order lines filled in.
